versions.changelog:
- Initial release of evez-fleet skill.
- Provides scripts for deploying and configuring the EVEZ OpenClaw mesh on GCP and Vultr.
- Includes tools for automated provider integration, zero-cost GCP infrastructure setup, and gateway health monitoring.
- Documents architecture with Vultr primary and planned GCP nodes, featuring multi-layer resilience.
- Supports multiple free and low-cost LLM providers.
